title: Data Types Quiz: Numbers vs Text

questions.question: Which of the following creates a NUMBER (Integer) variable in Python?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Whole numbers written without quotes are treated as integers (numeric values).
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. Quotes ("100" or '100') make it a text string. To make a number, write the digits without quotes.

questions.question: What is the output of the following code snippet?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Because "5" has quotes, Python treats both as text strings and glues them together (concatenation) to produce "55".
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. Quotes make "5" a text string. The + operator connects (concatenates) strings together into "55".

questions.question: What happens if you write `name = Alice` without quotes around Alice?

options.text: Python crashes with a NameError because it searches for a variable named Alice
Python automatically adds quotes and creates a string
Python creates a number variable with value 0
Python prints Alice to the screen

questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Words without quotes are treated as variable names. Since no variable named Alice exists, Python raises a NameError.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. Any word without quotes is looked up as a variable. If it doesn't exist, Python raises NameError.

questions.question: You want to store a user's phone number. Why is storing it as a string (with quotes) usually preferred?

options.text: Phone numbers are text IDs that you never do math (like addition) on, and they can have leading zeros or hyphens
Python numbers cannot hold more than 3 digits
Strings take up zero memory in the computer
Integer numbers are not allowed in Python programs

questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Phone numbers and zip codes are identifier codes, not mathematical quantities, so they are best stored as strings.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Incorrect. Phone numbers are identifiers rather than math values (you don't add phone numbers), so text format is ideal.
